description: A class that implements event listeners for investment-related events within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It handles processes such as initiating investments, saving geolocation data, handling payment responses (success, failure, notification), sending email notifications, logging activities, and managing refunds and modifications of investments.

classes.name: InvestListener
classes.description: Event listener class that handles various investment-related events, including initialization, completion, refund, modification, and notification of investments within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: onInvestInit
methods.description: Handles the initial investment setup, associates investment with payment method, and saves geolocation data if enabled.

methods.name: onInvestInitSaveOrigin
methods.description: Saves the origin/source information of the investment based on user query parameters.

methods.name: onInvestInitRequest
methods.description: Logs and records the initiation of an investment request, marking the payment gateway as authorized.

methods.name: onInvestInitRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirection to the payment platform, logging the redirect event.

methods.name: onInvestComplete
methods.description: Handles post-payment completion, setting details and logging for the completed investment.

methods.name: onInvestCompleteRequest
methods.description: Sets transaction reference and logs request details for completing an investment.

methods.name: onInvestNotify
methods.description: Handles notifications from payment gateways about the investment status.

methods.name: onInvestFailed
methods.description: Handles failed investment attempts, logs errors, and creates admin and community feed entries.

methods.name: onInvestSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful investments: updates status, sends thank you emails, logs activities, and creates feed entries.

methods.name: onInvestRefundCancel
methods.description: Cancels an investment for reasons other than project failure and logs the process.

methods.name: onInvestRefundReturn
methods.description: Handles refunding an investment due to project failure, and logs the process.

methods.name: onInvestRefundFailed
methods.description: Handles failure during the refund process, logs the error message.

methods.name: onInvestFinished
methods.description: Finalizes an investment after user provides additional data, and updates geolocation info.

methods.name: onInvestModify
methods.description: Handles modifications to existing investments, logs the change.

methods.name: onKernelResponse
methods.description: Stops event propagation for specific controller actions related to payment notification to prevent further response handling.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping events to corresponding handler methods.
